summary: Saturday's session was weekend-only crypto trading, extending Friday's slide as December Fed rate-hike bets surged past 85% on CME FedWatch. Bitcoin ETFs bled roughly $1.3 billion over the week and forced liquidations topped $1 billion, dragging BTC toward $63,500 with RSI near 23. Stocks, bonds and gold simply carried over Friday's closes under the stronger dollar and higher real yields.
tweet: Weekend crypto-only trade: Fed hike bets near 85%, $1.3B in BTC ETF outflows and $1B+ liquidations drag bitcoin toward $63,500.
